dispatch.one_per: cluster carrying a KEEP or MERGE-target verdict in reconciliation.md

brief.preamble_text: Use WebSearch and WebFetch directly to find answers and return a structured brief. Do NOT invoke any skills, the Deep Research pipeline, or spawn agents/teams. Your job is a quick solo web search — 5-10 minutes, a handful of queries, a clear brief back to me.
brief.appended: the cluster's own scope text, verbatim from reconciliation.md
brief.composition: preamble_text, then a blank line, then the cluster scope. Nothing else — no EM commentary, no per-cluster prompt authoring.

output.min_bytes_note: the SKILL's >=2KB floor; a scout returning less has not grounded the cluster

depth_disposition.source: the PM's step-1.5.0 disposition — an INPUT to this op, never computed by it
depth_disposition.deep-research: emit a directive naming the cluster; dispatch nothing
depth_disposition.mixed: per-cluster — the disposition carries which clusters take which

excluded_clusters.source: an INPUT to this op — a set of cluster ids the caller has already resolved as ineligible
excluded_clusters.note: The UE-internal-API precondition is the standing producer of this set: a UE cluster whose project-rag probe does not return a hit STOPS, and a web scout is never dispatched in its place. The probe itself is project-rag's capability and is deliberately not this op's job — the op consumes the resolved exclusion set.

never.rule: Never invoke /research or the Deep Research pipeline. It is PM-gated and never EM-auto-invoked, so a deep-research cluster yields a directive, never a dispatch.
Never dispatch a web scout for an excluded cluster. A confident web brief on a question the web cannot answer is worse than an absent one.

Never dispatch for a cluster whose research-corpus file is measurement-derived. That file is EM-authored ground truth written by hand from probe output, a prior spike, or direct inspection, and it REPLACES the scout outright. Overwriting it with scout output launders measurement into search results.
Never author or vary the brief per cluster. The preamble is fixed and inlined verbatim; only the appended cluster scope differs.
